_apiKey: Deliberately absent. The key is read from LIS_ANALYZER_API_KEY (.env.local in a checkout; injected by the service supervisor in the installed app), so there is exactly one copy of it and it is never committed.

machines._note: protocol 'auto' because the instrument's dialect is set on its control PC, not here: its own Lis.exe carries a hardcoded ASTM E1394-97 header record, yet it ships NIIHL7.dll beside NIIASTM.dll. The listener works out which from the first packet rather than betting on one and parsing nothing.
machines._transport: This instrument has no network, so serial is the likely path: set transport to 'serial' and it uses comPort/baud below. Change it back to 'tcp-server' the day it shares a network with the LIS. Neither needs internet — TCP here means one Ethernet cable and two static addresses, no router and no gateway, exactly as the Afinion 2 runs. protocol 'auto' means the dialect does not have to be known in advance on either path.
machines.name: Snibe Maglumi 800 (Immunoassay)
